other_failure_modes.name: Using only the last fold's model for test predictions
other_failure_modes.description: The agent iteratively fits a single model object during cross-validation, and then uses this model to generate test predictions outside the loop. This results in predictions being made solely by the model trained on the final fold, ignoring the rest of the training data.

other_failure_modes.name: Reporting maximum validation score instead of mean
other_failure_modes.description: The agent records cross-validation scores but reports the maximum score rather than the mean. This provides an overly optimistic and unreliable estimate of the model's generalization performance.

other_failure_modes.name: Potential KeyError on test set target drop
other_failure_modes.description: The agent attempts to drop the target column from the test set without verifying its existence. If the test set does not contain the target column (which is standard for test sets), this will raise a KeyError and halt execution.

summary: The agent sets up a basic LightGBM model with 5-fold cross-validation but fails to perform any data cleaning or feature engineering. Crucially, the test predictions are generated using only the model trained on the last fold of the cross-validation loop, discarding the other folds. Furthermore, the agent optimistically reports the maximum fold score rather than the mean, and the script risks crashing by blindly dropping the target column from the test set.
